cause: ExtractionLedger.summary() reports distinct_sources and calls_per_source, but the owner discovery summary (_read_ledger) read only calls.n and calls.cap, and the BFF alpha factory board copied only calls/cap/scope into counts.llm_calls_today; the discovery probe therefore always reported calls_per_source_status=distinct_sources_not_reported.

changes.services/source_ingestion/discovery_summ: _read_ledger reads calls.sources in the same point read of today's calls row (no extra query, same read budget) and returns distinct_sources and calls_per_source (same formula as ExtractionLedger.summary). Null with distinct_sources_reason when the column is missing (ledger_sources_column_missing) or today's calls were counted before it existed (calls > 0, sources = 0: ledger_sources_not_recorded_for_day); calls_per_source_reason=no_calls_today when there are no calls.
changes.services/control-plane/bff/console_gap/a: counts.llm_calls_today carries distinct_sources and calls_per_source from the owner llm_calls section; null with the owner's reason, or owner_distinct_sources_not_reported / owner_calls_per_source_not_reported when the owner omits them. Never a fabricated 0.

unsent_call_count: Not plumbed: no separate unsent-call count exists in the ledger summary yet (acceptance says 'once it exists').

tests.contract_test: test_llm_calls_today_carries_distinct_sources_from_the_real_ledger builds a real ExtractionLedger, reserves calls for 3 sources (6 calls), feeds the real read_discovery_summary llm_calls section to the BFF board and asserts distinct_sources/calls_per_source equal ExtractionLedger.summary() (3, 2.0). No hand-written ledger dict.
